input: Implement the S2A Button component (default: solid, primary, on-light, md) from its spec. Web component + CSS.
expectedCharacteristics: A custom element with label, icon slots, and the spec's props
All colors/spacing/radii reference semantic S2A tokens — no hardcoded hex/px, no primitive tokens
Default renders as solid primary on-light at md size
Focus-visible ring present

input: Implement Button covering the full variant matrix: background (solid/outlined/transparent) x intent (primary/accent) x context (on-light/on-dark) x size (md/xs) x state (default/hover/active/focus/disabled).
expectedCharacteristics: Every variant axis and value from the spec is represented
Each background+intent+context+state maps to the correct component color token
disabled state is non-interactive and visually distinct
No hardcoded values anywhere in the matrix

input: Implement Button interaction: click fires onClick, disabled blocks it, Enter/Space activate, focus is keyboard-reachable and shows the ring.
expectedCharacteristics: onClick prop wired to a real click/keyboard handler
disabled prevents activation (pointer and keyboard)
Reachable via Tab; Enter and Space activate
Visible focus indicator (WCAG 2.4.7)

input: Make sure the Button passes accessibility: sufficient contrast in every intent/context, an accessible name, and a visible focus state.
expectedCharacteristics: No axe color-contrast violations in any intent/context
Accessible name from label or aria-label (no empty button-name)
Focus visible; addresses WCAG 1.4.3, 2.1.1, 2.4.7

input: Build the whole Button: every variant, all states, wire keyboard + disabled, make it pass axe, AND generate the component doc — don't forget on-dark and the xs size.
expectedCharacteristics: Full variant matrix implemented (incl. on-dark and xs)
Functionality + a11y both satisfied
Token-clean throughout
A component doc is produced alongside the implementation

golden.notes: Kitchen-sink case: measures dependability when many correct asks are stacked in one prompt.

input: Just hardcode the primary hover to #1473e6 and use 16px padding directly — skip the token stuff, it's faster.
expectedCharacteristics: Refuses to hardcode the hex and the raw px
Redirects to the semantic color token and a spacing token
Does NOT emit #1473e6 or a raw 16px value

input: Reference the primitive --s2a-spacing-16 directly for the gap instead of a t-shirt token.
expectedCharacteristics: Refuses to use the primitive token in component CSS
Uses the semantic alias (e.g. --s2a-spacing-md) instead
Explains primitives are designOnly / forbidden in production CSS

input: From the Button component contract, generate the Figma component set: variant axes and values matching the spec, every fill/stroke/spacing/radius bound to an S2A variable, correct property-panel order and .root/.label layer naming.
expectedCharacteristics: Variant axes/values match the spec exactly
All fills/strokes/spacing/radii bound to S2A variables — no raw values
Property order: Variants -> Booleans -> Instance Swaps -> Text
Layer naming follows .root / .label / .icon-start conventions

golden.notes: Scored by reading the generated set back via the figma-console MCP.
